extDescription.message: Translate posts and draft operator-reviewed replies on Reddit, X, and Facebook.

personasIntro.message: A persona is the voice you reply in. It holds no product or promotion data.

personaIdentityHint.message: Who you are. Drafts use it to guide wording and never invent experience beyond it.

personaDeleteConfirm.message: Delete the persona "$1"? This cannot be undone.

apiKeysNote.message: Keys are stored on this device only and never sync to your other devices.

operatorLanguageHint.message: Pages are translated into this language, and reply drafts include a review copy in it.

aiFallback.message: Use the AI engine when Google translation fails

intentLabel.message: What do you want to say?

intentPlaceholder.message: Optional: the point you want this reply to make.

generateUnavailableHint.message: Reply drafting becomes available once you open a post on Reddit, X, or Facebook.

translateInputPlaceholder.message: Paste text to translate into your language.

translationTruncated.message: (The text was too long; only the beginning was translated.)

errorMissingApiKey.message: No API key is set for the selected engine. Add one in Settings.

errorRateLimited.message: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

errorHttp.message: The service returned an error. Check the API key and model, then try again.

errorNetwork.message: Network error. Check your connection and try again.

errorBadResponse.message: The service returned an unexpected response.

errorUnsupportedEngine.message: The selected engine does not support this action.

errorNotFound.message: This item was changed or deleted in another window. The list has been refreshed.

errorStorage.message: Could not read or save data in Chrome storage. Sync storage may be full, or saves are too frequent; try again shortly.

errorGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

personasResetConfirm.message: The saved personas cannot be read. Replace them with a fresh default persona? This cannot be undone.
